description: Create SQL migration for Row Level Security (RLS) on all user-owned tables (Task 8.4). Create a custom migration file that enables RLS and defines policies for tenant isolation based on app.user_id setting.
steps: Create a raw SQL migration file at apps/api/prisma/migrations/rls_policies/migration.sql (or use prisma migrate dev --create-only pattern)

In the migration, for each user-owned table (users, connected_services, sync_jobs via connected_services, tracks via external_refs, playlists, playlist_tracks, likes, playback_sessions, device_sessions, listening_events, notifications, privacy_settings): ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
Create RLS policies: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON <table> USING (user_id = current_setting('app.user_id')::uuid) for tables with direct user_id column
For tables without direct user_id (like sync_jobs via connected_service_id): create join-based policies or skip RLS (they will be accessed through service-layer checks)
Create a database role 'app_user' WITHOUT BYPASSRLS if not exists, and GRANT appropriate permissions
Document in a comment which tables have RLS and which rely on service-layer checks
Since we cannot run prisma migrate in this sandbox (no DB), validate the SQL syntax is correct and the approach matches PostgreSQL RLS best practices
Run pnpm run typecheck and pnpm run lint to verify no regressions
acceptance_criteria: RLS migration SQL file exists with ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY for user-owned tables
app_user role is created without BYPASSRLS
findings: Migration file created successfully. No running DB to test against, but SQL syntax is valid PostgreSQL. lint-staged ran prettier on JSON/md files during commit. All typecheck/build/test pass cleanly.
